description: 白狮面容衬着浓密浅色鬃毛，一只眼被遮住，皮革金属甲清楚可辨。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Rengar is an adult lionlike vastaya with white fur, a full pale mane, one covered eye, a broad feline muzzle, and tribal leather-and-metal armor. Opaque layered clothing covers the torso and legs, while his hunting knife stays sheathed and his feline paws, tail, and clawed gauntlets remain distinct.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ivory fur, leather, fern green, sun gold; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
